thread:
Anna (CS): Quick sync — Quillix dedicated onboarding this week. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a short load-test window. Renewal health looks OK but they asked for a performance report to remove a billing hold. Can we lock this down by EOD?
Sam (Infra): @Anna — what's target steady RPS and p95 latency we should tune for?
Miguel (PM): Quillix SLA = 200 rps steady, burst to 900 for 10m windows. p95 target ≤ 220ms on us-west. They emphasized cold-starts are a big concern.
Priya (Oncall): I can run the smoke and soak tests during our mid-day window. Which pool (gpu-type) are we using for dedicated?
Sam (Infra): We'll serve from ded-pool-g6. GPU mem ~48G; suggested batch size 32 for short seqs. For autoscale, propose: scale-up at 60% GPU util or 180 rps, scale-down after 5m idle. Thoughts?
Anna (CS): That sounds reasonable. Capture action: 1) Sam publish autoscale policy, 2) Priya run load scripts, 3) Miguel confirm test script matches customer load pattern, 4) I'll gather feedback & performance report for billing.
Miguel (PM): I'll check Quillix traffic traces and produce a 3-min burst profile. Also we need a canary traffic shift plan in case the ded pool hits thermal limits.
Sam (Infra): Canary plan: 5% shadow traffic to dedicated pool for 30m, check error rate + latency, then ramp to 25% for 20m before full cutover. If error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 300ms, rollback.
Priya (Oncall): Scheduling note — prefer test window 2026-06-02 14:00-16:00 UTC. I'll add oncall coverage.
Anna (CS): Flagging renewal risk: Quillix finance wants evidence of predictable latency under peak. I'll attach the perf report and ask for a short joint call if numbers slip.
capacity-bot: slot reserved: ded-pool-g6 @2026-06-02 14:00-16:00 UTC by Priya. Reservation ID: RB-8812.
Sam (Infra): Load test command for reference:
```
locust -f tests/quillix_sim.py --headless -u 900 -r 100 --run-time 20m --host https://api.redwood.example
```
Also use the helper script to prime KV cache: `scripts/prime_kv.sh --model quillix-v1 --clients 50`.
Miguel (PM): Test data checklist: - token distribution matching 1024 median - 10% tool-calls - 2% rerank requests. I'll drop the dataset in /shared/quillix/testset-v2 and ping when done.
Priya (Oncall): Quick autoscale policy snippet (Sam, tweak if needed):
```
policy: {
  "scale_up": {"gpu_util_pct": 60, "min_delta_instances": 1},
  "scale_down": {"idle_minutes": 5},
  "max_instances": 20,
  "min_instances": 2
}
```
Sam (Infra): I'll formalize into infra config and push PR to infra-oncall repo. ETA 3h.
Anna (CS): For feedback capture — after tests, I'll send a short 5-question survey to Quillix PMs and ops: perf ok? regressions? warm starts? cost impact? ease of autoscale? Please drop any qualitative notes in thread.
Miguel (PM): Added two items: sample client-side timeout to test partial failures; and a note to verify fallback routing to hosted models if dedicated pool saturates.
Priya (Oncall): I'll run a dry-run tomorrow in staging with 50% of target traffic to validate scripts. Will report logs here.
Anna (CS): Great — thanks everyone. I'll compile the perf report template and share before EOD for review. :thumbsup: If anyone spots a blocker ping here or DM me.
Sam (Infra): quick heads-up: thermal-sensor alert threshold currently at 85C; infra may cap bursts if servers hit that. I'll add a monitoring alert to notify us during the run.
capacity-bot: monitoring alert rule created: gpu-temp-high -> #eng-oncall. Threshold 82C.
Anna (CS): Perfect. Closing loop: Meeting? If numbers look marginal we do a 30-min incident playbook with Quillix present. Otherwise deliver the report and next renewal checkpoint.
Miguel (PM): Aiming to have test dataset + traffic profile uploaded by 2026-06-01 18:00 UTC.
Priya (Oncall): I'll post the staging dry-run logs here after tomorrow's test.
Anna (CS): Thanks team — will follow up with the template and call invite if needed.
